in_marathi.name: Guruprasad

in_marathi.long_meaning: Guruprasad हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। The name Guruprasad is derived from Sanskrit words 'Guru' (teacher, guide) and 'Prasad' (blessing, grace). This name signifies receiving the blessings and grace of a revered teacher or guru.
